# awsappstream_image_permissions (Data Source)

Reads sharing permissions for a private AppStream image. This data source can be used to inspect which AWS accounts a private image is shared with and how those accounts are permitted to use the image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awsappstream_image_permissions" "example" {
  name = "example-image"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the private AppStream image for which permissions are read.

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes Set) The list of AWS accounts the image is shared with and their corresponding permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `image_permissions` (Attributes) Defines how the shared AWS account is allowed to use the image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--image_permissions))
- `shared_account_id` (String) The AWS account ID with which the image is shared.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions--image_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions.image_permissions`

Read-Only:

- `allow_fleet` (Boolean) Whether the image can be used to create or update AppStream fleets.
- `allow_image_builder` (Boolean) Whether the image can be used to create AppStream image builders.
